note_en: The withdrawal the fact describes is in the Discord record. On 4 July 2026 Timmy posted a hardware specification to the research server headed "authoritative hardware parameters" that supersede the earlier design spec. It states the module pore size is 0.2 um microfiltration and not a 50 kDa cut-off, and it flags that 0.2 um passes small outer-membrane vesicles and cell debris, asking that the earlier "50 kDa MWCO" and "blocks OMV" wording be revised.
note_zh: 事實所說的撤回在 Discord 紀錄中可以找到。2026 年 7 月 4 日 Timmy 在研究伺服器貼出一份硬體規格，標明為取代舊版設計規格的權威參數。該文寫明模組孔徑為 0.2 微米微過濾，而非 50 kDa 截留分子量，並註明 0.2 微米會讓小型外膜囊泡與細胞碎片通過，要求修正舊規格中「50 kDa MWCO」與「阻擋 OMV」的說法。

evidence.quote: - Pore size: 0.2 µm (MICROFILTRATION — NOT 50 kDa MWCO; correct spec v0.1)
- CAVEAT: 0.2 µm passes ACCD (~36 kDa) but also small OMVs / cell debris;

note_en: Discord narrows the version question. Through September the hardware team worked with four prototypes, not seven: Jacquelyn's diagram set is labelled prototype 1 (6 June), 2 (14 June) and 3 (10 July), and the September integration build is prototype 4, which Chars describes as having no filter on the pressure transducer but a sampler on the lumen side. Joshua says prototype 3 was never drawn because it was not marked as a DBTL cycle at the time, which is why some versions have no Design-Build-Test-Learn entries.
note_zh: Discord 把版本的問題收窄了。到九月為止硬體組處理的是四個原型而不是七個：Jacquelyn 的圖檔標為原型 1（6 月 6 日）、2（6 月 14 日）與 3（7 月 10 日），九月整合的那一台是原型 4，Chars 說它的壓力轉換器沒有加濾器，但在 lumen 側裝了取樣口。Joshua 說原型 3 當時沒有畫圖，因為當時沒有把它當成一個 DBTL 循環，這正是某些版本沒有 Design-Build-Test-Learn 紀錄的原因。

evidence.quote: cuz the presentation only goes till v 4
we didn't draw for that one cuz we didn't mark it as a dbtl at the time
In this version 4, we did not give pressure transducer a  filter.

note_en: Discord contradicts "no clone and no date on record" for module H. On 12 August Sophie Chen posted sequencing results that include clone #H1, and on 14 September Chloe reported a bright 740 bp colony-PCR band for H with csn fw and pEXP_seq rv primers and said they would set up liquid culture. Named H isolates and dated work on them therefore exist; what Discord shows is that the H sequencing came back unsuccessful, not that no clone was ever obtained.
note_zh: Discord 與「模組 H 沒有任何 clone、也沒有日期紀錄」相牴觸。8 月 12 日 Sophie Chen 貼出的定序結果包含 #H1；9 月 14 日 Chloe 報告 H 的 colony PCR 在 740 bp 有一條很亮的帶（引子為 csn fw 與 pEXP_seq rv），並說之後會做液體培養。因此有具名的 H 菌落與對應日期；Discord 顯示的是 H 的定序結果不成功，而不是從未取得 clone。

evidence.quote: #H1: unsuccessful..
H has one really bright good one at 740 bp (we used csn fw and pEXP_seq rv), so we will do liquid culture later

note_en: The pinned construct list supports thirteen as the count of the lettered A-to-M series but not as the total. Sophie Chen's 25 August list runs A to S plus V and X, with A to M being the thirteen modules the Results table appears to cover and N to S being the later SamyQ fusions. Anyone citing thirteen should say which letters it covers.
note_zh: 釘選的構築清單支持「十三」是 A 到 M 這一系列的數目，但不是總數。Sophie Chen 8 月 25 日的清單從 A 排到 S，另加 V 與 X；A 到 M 正好十三個，應該就是 Results 表格涵蓋的範圍，N 到 S 則是後來的 SamyQ 融合構築。引用十三這個數字時應說明涵蓋哪些字母。

note_en: Discord shows where one of the four cell-size figures comes from. The 4 July hardware specification states that B. subtilis cells of 1 to 2 um are fully retained, and gives no source for that size. The same document is the only place in the Discord record that puts a number on the cell size, so the other three figures on the wiki are not traceable to it either.
note_zh: Discord 顯示了四個細胞尺寸數字中其中一個的來源。7 月 4 日的硬體規格寫著 1 至 2 微米的枯草桿菌細胞會被完全截留，但沒有附任何出處。該文件也是 Discord 紀錄中唯一給出細胞尺寸數字的地方，因此 wiki 上的另外三個數字同樣無法由此追溯。

evidence.quote: - Retention: B. subtilis cells (1–2 µm) fully retained → biocontainment intact

note_en: The duty cycles the status note calls unrecorded are in Discord. Anton Lin's 16 July light-plate sketch drives the three channels at analogWrite values of 80, 160 and 255, which he annotates as about 31, 63 and 100 per cent duty. The 19 September run used the same idea, with green set to 100, 12 and 2 per cent across the plate. So the tiers do come from the duty cycle, and the numbers exist.
note_zh: 狀態註記說沒有紀錄的 duty cycle，其實在 Discord 裡。Anton Lin 7 月 16 日的光板程式把三個通道分別設為 analogWrite 80、160、255，他註明約為 31%、63% 與 100% duty。9 月 19 日那次實驗沿用同樣作法，綠光在整個板子上分別設為 100%、12% 與 2%。所以強度階層確實來自 duty cycle，而且數值是有紀錄的。

evidence.quote: analogWrite(PIN_LIGHT1, 80);   // ~31% duty cycle
Un 01-03 Green 100% ;

note_en: Discord shows the team knew about the lux problem and left it open. On 19 June Timmy noted that the Castillo-Hair paper reports PPFD and not lux, said he was buying a cheap lux meter, and set "figure out how to go from lux to ppfd" as a task for the hardware group. Nothing later in either server reports the conversion being done.
note_zh: Discord 顯示團隊知道 lux 的問題，而且一直沒有解決。6 月 19 日 Timmy 指出 Castillo-Hair 論文用的單位是 PPFD 而非 lux，說他要買一個便宜的照度計，並把「弄清楚怎麼從 lux 換算到 ppfd」交給硬體組。兩個伺服器之後都沒有任何訊息說這個換算做好了。

evidence.quote: Castillo paper unit is ppfd, not lux
Figure out how to go from lux to ppfd

note_en: Discord settles this in favour of 520 and 660 nm. The 4 July hardware specification, posted as the authoritative build parameters that supersede the earlier design spec, lists 520 nm green for CcaSR ON and 660 nm red for CcaSR OFF. No message in either server gives 535 or 670 nm, so the Engineering page's figures are the wrong ones. The spec also confirms these come from the literature, citing Castillo-Hair 2019 whose measurement wavelength was 526 nm.
note_zh: Discord 在這一點上支持 520 與 660 奈米。7 月 4 日貼出的硬體規格自述為取代舊設計規格的權威建置參數，其中列出綠光 520 奈米使 CcaSR 開啟、紅光 660 奈米使其關閉。兩個伺服器都沒有任何訊息提到 535 或 670 奈米，因此 Engineering 頁面的數字是錯的。該規格也確認這些數字出自文獻，引用的是 Castillo-Hair 2019，其量測波長為 526 奈米。

evidence.quote: - LEDs: 520 nm green (CcaSR ON) + 660 nm red (CcaSR OFF), PWM analog modulation

note_en: Discord contradicts the claim that the array never ran a CcaS/CcaR experiment on a live culture. On 19 September Timmy posted the layout of "LPA test1 ACCD lv2", with units set to green at 100, 12 and 2 per cent and red at the same three levels, sampled from two hours. Two days later Chloe Wu posted the resulting gels, loaded as LPA 0 followed by green 100 and green 12 at two, four, six and eight hours, with a second gel for green 2 and red 100. An OD results workbook from the same run was posted on 3 October. Green dose, duration and an expression readout were therefore paired.
note_zh: Discord 與「光板從未在活菌培養上跑過 CcaS/CcaR 實驗」這個說法相牴觸。9 月 19 日 Timmy 貼出「LPA test1 ACCD lv2」的配置，各管綠光設為 100%、12%、2%，紅光也是同樣三個強度，從兩小時開始取樣。兩天後 Chloe Wu 貼出跑出來的膠，上樣順序為 LPA 0 之後接綠光 100 與綠光 12 的 2、4、6、8 小時，第二片膠則是綠光 2 與紅光 100。同一次實驗的 OD 結果檔案在 10 月 3 日貼出。因此綠光劑量、時間與表現量讀值確實有配對。

evidence.quote: 20260919 LPA test1 ACCD lv2:
this is the result for the M1 gel of our LPA testing on Saturday. The loading order was M1, LPA 0, G100 2 hr, G100 4 hr, G100 6 hr, G100 8 hr, G12 2 hr, G12 4 hr, G12 6 hr, G12 8 hr

note_en: Discord confirms the light half-saturation constant but not the activity span. The 4 July hardware specification gives the CcaSR v1.0 parameters from Castillo-Hair 2019 as K half of 4.66 plus or minus 0.63 umol per square metre per second at 526 nm, with an ON half time of 105.1 minutes and an OFF half time of 74.97 minutes. The permeate activity range and the 3.3 to 5.7 hour ON half time at 22 degrees do not appear anywhere in the record.
note_zh: Discord 確認了光半飽和常數，但沒有確認活性範圍。7 月 4 日的硬體規格列出取自 Castillo-Hair 2019 的 CcaSR v1.0 參數：K½ 為 4.66±0.63 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹（526 奈米），開啟半衰期 105.1 分鐘，關閉半衰期 74.97 分鐘。透過液活性範圍與 22 度下 3.3 至 5.7 小時的開啟半衰期，在紀錄中都找不到。

evidence.quote: - CcaSR v1.0 (Castillo-Hair 2019): Hill n=1.88±0.16; K½=4.66±0.63 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹

note_en: Discord names the agent that went into the hydroponic boxes, which the fact says no file does. The daily progression posts call it CH bio peptide: Alex added it to the pre-treatment hydroponics on 14 August, to the co-treatment on 20 August and to the post-treatment on 21 August, matching the pre, co and post arms the notebooks record. The same name runs through the agar arms of the August trials.
note_zh: Discord 寫出了加進水耕盒的藥劑名稱，而事實宣稱沒有任何檔案記載。每日進度貼文稱之為 CH bio peptide：Alex 在 8 月 14 日加入水耕前處理組、8 月 20 日加入同時處理組、8 月 21 日加入後處理組，與實驗記錄本上的前、同、後三組吻合。同一個名稱也貫穿八月洋菜試驗的各組。

evidence.quote: D. Add CH bio peptide to pre treatment (hydroponics)
F. Add CH protectant to post treatment

note_en: Discord supports the fact for most of the season and shows when it stopped being safe to assert. On 8 August Ryan Yuan wrote that the protectant team would finish ACCD first and move on to LEA and BoPep4 afterwards. Plant trials for the two did not get scheduled until late September, when Abigail listed agar plates vernalised on 19 September as planned for LEA and BoPep testing in salinity trials. Whether those trials ran is outside this corpus, which was pulled on 14 October.
note_zh: Discord 在今年大半時間支持這項事實，也顯示它從何時起不再安全。8 月 8 日 Ryan Yuan 寫道保護劑組會先完成 ACCD，之後才處理 LEA 與 BoPep4。這兩者的植物試驗要到九月底才排入進度，Abigail 列出 9 月 19 日春化的洋菜培養皿，預定用於鹽逆境試驗中的 LEA 與 BoPep 測試。這些試驗是否真的執行，不在這份 10 月 14 日匯出的語料範圍內。

take out 9/19 vernalized agar plates into incubator(planned for lea/bopep testing in salinity trials)

note_en: Discord does not settle the ACC deaminase band size but adds two figures. The 4 July hardware specification calls ACCD about 36 kDa when arguing that a 0.2 um membrane passes it. On 21 September Chloe Wu read the light-plate gels as a band around 63 kDa with a monomer length of about 38 to 42 kDa. No message reports a measured band size for the August blots.

0.2 µm passes ACCD (~36 kDa)

note_en: Discord narrows the date. The SubtiToolKit paper was posted to the part-development thread by the instructor Chars on 11 June 2026 as an attachment, and by 18 June Sophie Chen was asking Gabriel whether the SubtiToolKit insert should use the RBS from the paper or the one supplied with the kit. pSTK vectors run through the cloning record from that point. note_en: The scaled-down figures are in the record verbatim. Timmy's 27 June module table gives membrane area 200 square centimetres (0.02 square metres), 11 fibres, 1.0 mm lumen, flow 129 mL per minute at 2000 per second and 388 mL per minute at 6000 per second. Two cautions attach. Chars had said on 24 June that 2000 per second is only a recommended industrial minimum and not a requirement, and the 4 July hardware specification explicitly replaces this M+/200 square centimetre/11-fibre record with 150 square centimetres, 8 fibres and 94 and 282 mL per minute.
note_zh: 縮小版的數字在紀錄中原樣可見。Timmy 6 月 27 日的模組表列出膜面積 200 平方公分（0.02 平方公尺）、11 根纖維、管腔內徑 1.0 公釐，2000 s⁻¹ 時流量 129 mL/min、6000 s⁻¹ 時 388 mL/min。但有兩點要注意。Chars 在 6 月 24 日說 2000 s⁻¹ 只是工業上建議的最低剪切率，不是硬性要求；而 7 月 4 日的硬體規格明確以 150 平方公分、8 根纖維、94 與 282 mL/min 取代了這份 M+/200 平方公分/11 纖維的紀錄。

note_en: Discord gives the set-5 reading in the words of the person who made the graph. On 30 July Alex Li told the plant adviser that without stress 1 mM trehalose worked best, while under 150 mM NaCl stress 10 mM worked best, and that the chart was normalised to fresh weight. That names 1 mM and 10 mM as the two best doses for set 5, where the status note has 5 mM and 10 mM.
note_zh: Discord 以製圖者本人的話給出了第 5 組的判讀。7 月 30 日 Alex Li 告訴植物顧問，在沒有逆境時 1 mM 海藻糖效果最好，而在 150 mM NaCl 逆境下則是 10 mM 最好，並說該圖是以鮮重標準化的。這把第 5 組的兩個最佳劑量指為 1 mM 與 10 mM，而狀態註記寫的是 5 mM 與 10 mM。

evidence.quote: 在沒有stress的時候，1mM trehalose 效果最好。但在有150mM NaCl stress的時候，10mM 的trehalose 效果最好。

note_en: Discord records the 19 July session but with different numbers. Chars announced that evening that the inline spectrophotometer finally gave a reasonable reading and confirmed it could see the titanium dioxide, then found it overestimating about four-fold and suspected the blank, saying he could not clean the flow cuvette before blanking. After adding a manual blank entry to the code he reported the reading as a little lower than the Bio-Drop, 0.100 against 0.149. Neither the fall from 20 to 8 per cent nor the 6.4 per cent reference shift appears.
note_zh: Discord 記錄了 7 月 19 日這次測試，但數字不同。Chars 當晚宣布線上分光光度計終於給出合理讀值，並確認它看得到二氧化鈦，接著發現高估約四倍，懷疑是空白的問題，說他沒辦法在歸零前清洗流動比色槽。在程式中加入手動輸入空白後，他回報讀值比 Bio-Drop 略低，0.100 對 0.149。從 20% 降到 8% 的說法與 6.4% 的參考光偏移都沒有出現。

evidence.quote: Looks like it overestimates around 4-fold
It turns out that the reading is a little bit lower than biodrop (0.100 and 0.149)

note_en: Discord explains how two percentage ranges came to exist. Chars posted the experiment on 18 August with two files, the spreadsheet 260816_pressure_to_flow_rate.xlsx holding the data and a PDF report holding the analysis, and said in the same message that the PDF analysis was produced by Claude. The 46 to 55 per cent and 43 to 56 per cent figures are therefore both downstream of an automated pass over the same spreadsheet, so the spreadsheet is what should be recomputed.
note_zh: Discord 說明了兩個百分比範圍是怎麼來的。Chars 在 8 月 18 日貼出這次實驗，附上兩個檔案：資料在 260816_pressure_to_flow_rate.xlsx，分析在一份 PDF 報告，他在同一則訊息中說 PDF 的分析是由 Claude 產生的。因此 46 至 55% 與 43 至 56% 兩組數字都是對同一份試算表自動分析的產物，應該重算的是那份試算表。

evidence.quote: The Excel is the data and pdf is the result analysis by claude.
